details.label: HOW TO ASSEMBLE
details.body: ASSEMBLING YOUR BELT:A. Take the belt strap with the single hole and position it on the side of the desired color.B. Pass the belt strap through the buckle, starting at the trigger guard (the part of the buckle that holds the strap).C. Fasten the buckle's collar button (part of the buckle that inserts into the belt hole to close it) in the perforationD. Equip yourself with the color-matched loop and slip it over the strap (part of the 5 holes).E. Your belt is ready ADJUST YOUR BELT:A. Place your belt around you, starting from the left.B. Pass the strap (part with the 5 holes) through the trigger guard of the buckle.C. Adjust the belt by fastening the collar button in the desired position. RECOMMENDATIONWe recommend storing the belt loops in the original box to avoid misplacing them.
details.html:
ASSEMBLING YOUR BELT:

A. Take the belt strap with the single hole and position it on the side of the desired color.

B. Pass the belt strap through the buckle, starting at the trigger guard (the part of the buckle that holds the strap).

C. Fasten the buckle's collar button (part of the buckle that inserts into the belt hole to close it) in the perforation

D. Equip yourself with the color-matched loop and slip it over the strap (part of the 5 holes).

E. Your belt is ready

 

ADJUST YOUR BELT:

A. Place your belt around you, starting from the left.

B. Pass the strap (part with the 5 holes) through the trigger guard of the buckle.

C. Adjust the belt by fastening the collar button in the desired position.

 

RECOMMENDATION

We recommend storing the belt loops in the original box to avoid misplacing them.
